_comment: Named address ranges of The Simpsons Game (USA, default.xex) image for the inventory. kind: library = statically linked SDK / middleware, replaced as a unit by Any360; game = the title's own code. Evidence: the port's re/d3d_method_table.md (D3D command-writer handlers sub_82461500..), its crt_native.cpp bindings (0x82A3Cxxx), the import thunks in generated simpsons_init.cpp (0x82CC2xxx). Ranges outside the list are reported by 1 MB area until symbol recovery (stage 2) names them.
